findings.title: Frozen DTO compatibility restored
findings.result: ReviewedMedia approvalAudit is strict {eventId,createdAt}; PrivateDraftReview exposes only identity/drafts/checks/canPublish; ReviewCheck retains generic string id and project/site scope. Positive and malformed schema probes pass.
limits: Embedded PGlite and synthetic auth only; no provider API run.

findings.title: Publish and rollback consume activePublication on refresh
findings.result: Both refresh paths require activePublication and use its revision; exact-source Chromium observed the committed publish and rollback update the review identity without a page reload.
limits: Local Chromium/PGlite fixture; CDN/edge and deployed-origin behavior were not tested.

findings.title: Missing genuine draft follows 404/notFound paths
findings.result: Requested absent drafts return null before strict review construction; the owner API returns private 404 and the page calls notFound() for an absent review/draft. Integration verifies status, private headers, and no CandidateX content.
limits: The page-level Next notFound branch was confirmed by source inspection; this rerun did not launch a browser request for the absent page.

findings.title: Authorized stale-save response returns current draft without writes
findings.result: A stale 409 includes projectId, current revision, and complete current project; integration verifies no publication/draft/audit writes and unauthenticated callers do not receive current content. Chromium confirms the losing rich editor buffer remains visible.
limits: PGlite and owner-cookie fixture; native PostgreSQL multi-process races were not run.

findings.title: Draft renderer accepts only the exact canonical private-media URL
findings.result: Draft rendering sets img src only when the supplied URL exactly equals /api/admin/preview/media/{encodeURIComponent(mediaId)}. Unit probes reject absolute/origin-confused, traversal, mismatched-ID, and query variants.
limits: The exact-string source guard also rejects fragments and alternate encodings; the unit list does not include a separate literal fragment probe.

findings.title: New authoring defaults are empty or explicitly unknown
findings.result: New section, paragraph, list, code, and link text fields begin empty; link URL/check time are empty; evidence URL/check time are null and status unknown. Unit and Chromium assertions pass.
limits: The UI run used synthetic local draft data and did not write production content.

processBoundaryIncident: FINISH-39 records that FINISH-37 output roots were opened and altered during earlier parent work despite the preceding no-open instruction. This report did not inspect or use FINISH-37 through FINISH-41 output contents as evidence.
